title: The Leaders in Jerusalem

questions.question: Who lived in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:1 (ESV): "Now the leaders of the people lived in Jerusalem..."

questions.question: How were the rest of the people chosen to live in Jerusalem?
options: They cast lots to bring one out of ten
questions.correctAnswer: They cast lots to bring one out of ten
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:1 (ESV): "...the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in Jerusalem..."

questions.question: What is Jerusalem called in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:1 (ESV): "...to live in Jerusalem the holy city..."

questions.question: What did the people do for those who willingly offered to live in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:2 (ESV): "And the people blessed all the men who willingly offered to live in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Which tribes are specifically mentioned as living in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:4 (ESV): "...Some of the people of Judah and some of the people of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem."

questions.question: How many valiant men of Judah lived in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:6 (ESV): "All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were 468 valiant men."

questions.question: Who was the overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:22 (ESV): "The overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani..."

questions.question: What was the specific duty of the singers?
options: There was a fixed rule for them concerning their duty day by day
questions.correctAnswer: There was a fixed rule for them concerning their duty day by day
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:23 (ESV): "...and a fixed rule for the singers concerning their duty day by day."

questions.question: Who was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:24 (ESV): "And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel... was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people."

questions.question: Where did the rest of Israel live?
options: In all the towns of Judah, everyone in his inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: In all the towns of Judah, everyone in his inheritance
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:20 (ESV): "And the rest of Israel... were in all the towns of Judah, everyone in his inheritance."

questions.question: Who was the overseer of the city (civil/military)?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:9 (ESV): "And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer..."

questions.question: Who was second over the city?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:9 (ESV): "...and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city."

questions.question: How many men of Benjamin were there?
What villages with their fields are mentioned for the people of Judah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:25 (ESV): "...some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba... and in Dibon... and in Jekabzeel..."

questions.question: Who lived in Ophel?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 11:21 (ESV): "But the temple servants lived on Ophel..."

key_verse_text: Now the leaders of the people lived in Jerusalem. And the rest of the people cast lots to bring one out of ten to live in Jerusalem the holy city, while nine out of ten remained in the other towns.
